interviews.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
interviews.subtitle: Technical Interview
questions: Tell me about yourself and your professional background. What makes you a strong candidate for this role?
Describe the most challenging project you've worked on. How did you approach it and what was the outcome?
What are your strongest technical skills and how have you applied them in real-world scenarios?
How do you handle tight deadlines and competing priorities? Give a specific example.
Where do you see yourself professionally in the next 3–5 years, and how does this role align with those goals?

interviews.title: Python Developer
interviews.subtitle: Technical Interview
questions: Tell me about yourself and your professional background as a Python developer. What makes you a strong candidate for this role?
Describe the most challenging Python project you've worked on. How did you approach it and what was the outcome?
How do you handle memory management and performance optimization in Python applications?
Walk me through how you would design a REST API using a framework like Django or FastAPI.
Where do you see yourself professionally in the next 3–5 years, and how does this role align with those goals?

interviews.title: Node.js Developer
interviews.subtitle: Technical Interview
questions: Tell me about yourself and your professional background as a Node.js developer. What makes you a strong candidate for this role?
Describe the most challenging Node.js project you've worked on. How did you approach it and what was the outcome?
How do you handle asynchronous operations and the event loop in Node.js? Give a practical example.
Walk me through how you would design and scale a REST API or microservice using Express or a similar framework.
Where do you see yourself professionally in the next 3–5 years, and how does this role align with those goals?
